findings.issue: Production Caddyfile missing API subdomain block — chat-api.mainecybertech.com DNS exists but Caddy does not serve it
findings.impact: Direct API access to production API subdomain gets no TLS termination — mysterious connection failures
findings.fix: Add site block for chat-api.mainecybertech.com to Caddyfile.prod, or remove the unused DNS record

findings.issue: Same Terraform state key for both environments — no environment isolation in state key
findings.impact: Dev and prod Terraform operations use the same state — one environment's changes can corrupt the other

findings.issue: API env schema and shared config package have 11 variable mismatches (optional vs required, missing vars, name conflicts)
findings.impact: API starts with missing required config; EMAIL_FROM vs SMTP_FROM name collision causes silent fallback
findings.fix: Synchronize env.ts with env-schema.ts; resolve EMAIL_FROM/SMTP_FROM naming; add REDIS_TLS, SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT, VAPID_SUBJECT

findings.issue: SMTP/email env vars not set in any deployment workflow — SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, EMAIL_FROM all missing
findings.impact: Password reset emails and transactional emails will fail in deployed environments
findings.fix: Add SMTP configuration with SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, EMAIL_FROM secrets to both deploy workflows

findings.issue: Sentry DSN never set in any deployment — SENTRY_DSN and NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN not configured
findings.impact: Error tracking in deployed environments silently falls back to unconfigured state — no error capture
findings.fix: Add SENTRY_DSN and NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN secrets to both deploy workflows

findings.issue: Dev API subdomain (chat-api.mainecybertech.us) deployed but unused — DNS + Caddy block but nothing uses it
findings.impact: Wasted TLS cert issuance, DNS record, and Caddy config — all API traffic goes through same-domain /v1/* proxy
findings.fix: Remove API subdomain DNS record for development, or document as future architecture option

findings.issue: Web env schema missing 4 validated variables: NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION, NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA, NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME
findings.impact: Version badge always shows '0.0.0-dev' and 'local' in production; Sentry not configured on frontend
findings.fix: Add these vars to apps/web/lib/env.ts Zod schema

findings.issue: Default droplet size is s-1vcpu-512mb-10gb but 512MB is known to cause OOM (documented in AGENTS.md)
findings.impact: Development droplet will run out of memory under normal load
findings.fix: Update default droplet size to s-2vcpu-2gb in terraform variables.tf

findings.issue: Supabase migrations use same SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF for both dev and prod — no separate Supabase project
findings.impact: Migrations applied via develop branch directly affect the same database as main
findings.fix: Use separate Supabase projects for development and production with separate project ref secrets

findings.issue: No frontend feature flag client — flags only available server-side through API
findings.impact: Cannot gate frontend features with feature flags; flag evaluation requires API round-trip
findings.fix: Create frontend feature flag client (or inject flags from server props) for client-side feature gating

findings.issue: Feature flags use in-memory cache per instance — no Redis-backed cache invalidation
findings.impact: Multi-instance deployments see stale flag state up to 60s; flag change on one instance invalidates only that instance's cache
findings.fix: Use Redis pub/sub for cross-instance cache invalidation

findings.issue: Dev Caddyfile lacks static asset caching that prod has — no Cache-Control max-age for static assets
findings.impact: Development environment serves static assets without browser caching — slower local dev experience
findings.fix: Add @static matcher with max-age directive to dev Caddyfile

findings.issue: Push subscription service reads VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY and EMAIL_FROM directly from process.env instead of validated env schema
findings.impact: Env var validation bypassed — missing vars cause silent runtime failures instead of startup errors
findings.fix: Import validated env config instead of reading process.env directly
